stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DiscoveredInert : manifest parsed without execution
    DiscoveredInert --> Blocked : malformed missing or incompatible
    DiscoveredInert --> AttestedDisabled : core records identity version and hash
    AttestedDisabled --> EnabledPinned : explicit core enable and fresh attestation
    EnabledPinned --> Launching : approved invocation or authorized warm start
    Launching --> Healthy : protocol handshake matches pin
    Launching --> Degraded : launch handshake or health failure
    Healthy --> RunningInvocation : approved plugin call
    RunningInvocation --> Healthy : known terminal and cleanup
    RunningInvocation --> OutcomeUncertain : crash after possible effect
    Healthy --> Degraded : idle crash or failed heartbeat
    Degraded --> RestartBackoff : core authorizes restart within budget
    RestartBackoff --> Launching : backoff elapsed with no replay
    Degraded --> Quarantined : budget exhausted or identity drift
    OutcomeUncertain --> Quarantined : invocation is never auto-replayed
    Quarantined --> EnabledPinned : explicit repair and new attestation
    EnabledPinned --> Disabled : core disable
    Disabled --> [*]
    Blocked --> [*]

data.title: Trusted Plugin Discovery, Enablement, Health, Crash, and Restart
